title: World Cup Daily live: Happy Birthday to Lamine Yamal, and the World Cup itself - ESPN
text:
The semifinal lineup is set: the winners of France vs. Spain and England vs. Argentina will battle it out for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

Although there are no matches today, there will be no shortage of storylines as the four remaining teams prepare for the biggest games of the tournament and the fact one of the tournament's superstars, Lamine Yamal, is turning 19 is one of them!

Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition.
